entities.name: Phyrexian Invasion of Capenna
entities.description: Invasion of Capenna by Yawgmoth's Phyrexian forces.

entities.name: Capenna
entities.description: A medieval plane of knights, dragons and angels that became a wasteland save for the sealed city of New Capenna.

entities.name: Yawgmoth
entities.description: Leader of the invading Phyrexian forces.

entities.name: Phyrexians
entities.description: Invaders who reanimated and phyrexianized the dead.

entities.name: Archangels of Capenna
entities.description: Capenna's best warriors, who allied with the archdemons and were later trapped and turned into Halo.

entities.name: Archdemons of Capenna
entities.description: Powerful enemies of the angels who allied with them, then betrayed them.

entities.name: Halo
entities.description: Powerful substance made from the angels' bodies, harmful to Phyrexians and a power source for New Capenna.

entities.name: Xander
entities.description: Vampire raised to demonic status over the Maestros; later compleated.

entities.name: Jetmir
entities.description: Leonin raised to demon status over the Cabaretti.

entities.name: Raffine
entities.description: Sphinx seer raised to demon status over the Obscura.

entities.name: Falco Spara
entities.description: Aven raised to demon status over the Brokers.

entities.name: Ziatora
entities.description: Dragon raised to demon status over the Riveteers, sole surviving dragon.

entities.name: Elspeth Tirel
entities.description: A captive of the roaming Phyrexians, whose home plane was Capenna.

entities.name: Elesh Norn
entities.description: Sent Atraxa to command the second invasion.

entities.name: Atraxa
entities.description: Elesh Norn's greatest creation, commander of the second invasion, killed by the collapse of Park Heights.

entities.name: Ob Nixilis
entities.description: Active on the plane during the second invasion but of little help.

entities.name: Maestros
entities.description: Crime family led by Xander; compleated in the second invasion.

entities.name: Cabaretti
entities.description: Crime family led by Jetmir.

entities.name: Obscura
entities.description: Crime family led by Raffine.

entities.name: Brokers
entities.description: Crime family led by Falco Spara.

entities.name: Riveteers
entities.description: Crime family led by Ziatora.

entities.name: New Phyrexia
entities.description: Plane whose successor to Yawgmoth achieved interplanar transport.

entities.name: Park Heights
entities.description: Structure collapsed on Atraxa.

events.summary: The Phyrexians arrive on a ship and overwhelm Capenna's defenders, reanimating and phyrexianizing the dead over almost a year.
events.quote: their dead were reanimated and phyrexianized, joining the ranks of the Phyrexians

events.summary: The angels propose an alliance to the archdemons, who accept, and together turn back the tide of war.
events.quote: The demons accepted the alliance and, together with the angels, turned back the tide of war.

events.summary: Angels and demons build a fortress on a plateau that becomes New Capenna; the final fight takes place at the base of the elevators and the city is sealed.
events.quote: After the final elevator departed towards the city, New Capenna was sealed

events.summary: The archdemons betray the angels, turning their bodies into Halo, defeat the Phyrexians, and raise five individuals to demonic status over five factions.
events.quote: the archdemons proved their nature and captured the angels

events.summary: In the modern day Elesh Norn sends Atraxa to command a second Phyrexian invasion of Capenna.
events.quote: Elesh Norn sent her greatest creation, Atraxa, as the commander of this incursion.

events.summary: The gangs collapse the structure holding Park Heights on Atraxa, killing her; angels then leave via omenpaths for New Phyrexia and are stranded on Zhalfir.
events.quote: The gangs formulated a plan to collapse the structure holding Park Heights on Atraxa, which was successful in killing her.
